Throwing Combat Styles

Choose Throwing for hindering attacks or explosive area damage.

Throwing - Ordnance

Ordnance includes explosive area attacks and thrown attacks that can inflict effects such as Blind.

Throwing - Flurry

Flurry attacks can inflict Bleed or Hamstring, with additional effects against bleeding targets.
